html:
News Digest:

A survey of 60 Europe-based wealth managers and IFAs carried out by ETF issuer HANetf has found around 90% of respondents planning to up their portfolio allocation to thematic funds over the next 12 months.

 

Takeaway:

Assets under management at European-listed thematic ETFs, which stood at $41bn as of April, are forecast to increase to $91bn by December 31, the survey revealed, adding that 95% of respondents have seen increased demand for thematic exposure from clients.

 

 

End Notes
